findings.text: The test seeds version 1, so it passes even though the parser still uses version 2 keys and skips files whose incorrect text the previous extractor cached. Fix: Bump `EXTRACTOR_VERSION` to version 3 and seed the test with version 2.

For `deriving instance -- deriving instance` followed by `Repr for Tag` on the next line, the extractor accepts the keyword inside the line comment and drops the beginning of the command from the stored text. Fix: Start parsing only at actual `deriving` tokens and add a fixture that checks the full text of this command.

Reparsing in the module’s final environment loses the range of a valid `deriving instance Repr for Tag` when a later `syntax "Tag" : command` makes `Tag` a reserved token, so the store records only `Repr`. Fix: Use the syntax environment at the command’s source position and test this declaration order.
On an empty Lean file, natural-number subtraction makes the loop run once and `bytes[0]!` panics. Fix: Use `bytes.size + 1 - word.size` as the exclusive upper bound and test an empty source.

The ordinary-instance assertion also passes with the old regular expression because the comment’s `deriving` occurs mid-line and its `for` precedes the instance. Fix: Put `deriving instance` at the start of a line inside a block comment and place a real deriving command after the ordinary instance so the old matcher spans it.

The status says `deriving instance` in a comment cannot affect the stored text, but the parser can select those words inside a line comment as the start of the command. Fix: Limit the status claim to the specific fixture cases that pass.

A reader built before this commit emits no `derivingCommands` field, and the resulting diagnostic gives the module and expected shape without a recovery step. Fix: Tell the user to rebuild the fact reader and pass the rebuilt executable to `--reader`.
